title: What Self-Cooling Building Facades Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Self-cooling facades are building skins that reject heat passively: radiative-cooling panels, phase-change materials, and dynamic shading keeping interiors cool with minimal air conditioning.
